verdict.rationale: Penpot advertises open standards (CSS, HTML, SVG, JSON) and its own open file format, and self-hosting gives users control over where their data lives, which together support leaving without lock-in. However, no evidence documents a bulk 'export everything' workflow, and one hands-on report says exports were limited to individual layers rather than whole documents. Missing for 10: documented bulk/account-wide export of all files and assets, step-by-step export/migration docs, independent confirmation that full-fidelity exports work in practice.
